name: Requesty
description: AI gateway and LLM router for 600+ models. Intelligent routing, caching, failover, observability, and enterprise governance through a single OpenAI-compatible API.

skills.name: Chat Completions
skills.description: POST /v1/chat/completions - Send chat completion requests to 600+ AI models. Supports streaming, function calling, structured outputs, vision, and extended thinking. Docs: https://docs.requesty.ai/api-reference/endpoint/chat-completions-create

skills.name: Responses API
skills.description: POST /v1/responses - OpenAI Responses API for multi-turn conversations with built-in tool use, web search, file search, and computer use. Docs: https://docs.requesty.ai/api-reference/endpoint/responses-create

skills.name: Messages API
skills.description: POST /v1/messages - Anthropic Messages API for Claude models with native support for extended thinking, tool use, and vision. Docs: https://docs.requesty.ai/api-reference/endpoint/messages-create

skills.name: Intelligent Model Routing
skills.description: Route requests across 30+ providers by cost, latency, or availability. Weighted load balancing, automatic failover chains, and latency-based routing. Docs: https://docs.requesty.ai/features/fallback-policies

skills.name: Embeddings
skills.description: POST /v1/embeddings - Generate text embeddings using models from OpenAI, Cohere, Voyage, and more. Docs: https://docs.requesty.ai/api-reference/endpoint/embeddings-create

skills.name: MCP Gateway
skills.description: Unified gateway connecting AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code) to any MCP server with auth, analytics, and management. Docs: https://docs.requesty.ai/features/mcp-gateway

skills.name: Image Generation and Editing
skills.description: POST /v1/images/generations and /v1/images/edits - Generate and edit images using DALL-E, Stable Diffusion, and other models. Docs: https://docs.requesty.ai/api-reference/endpoint/images-generations-create

skills.name: Audio (TTS and Transcription)
skills.description: POST /v1/audio/speech for text-to-speech, POST /v1/audio/transcriptions for speech-to-text. Docs: https://docs.requesty.ai/api-reference/endpoint/audio-speech-create
